Trimmed recordings of real answers from the Danish Maritime Authority's
Niord server (https://niord.dma.dk, data owner Beredskabsstyrelsen),
fetched 2026-10-03. Public notices to mariners; used as test input only.

                         9 of the 277 messages: point (Local Warning-224-26),
                         multipoint (NM-403-25), coast-bounded open line
                         (NM-842-26), polygon (NM-879-26), firing exercise
                         with SIGNALS masts (EK D 396, no shortId), Greenland
                         (NM-887-26), no geometry (NM-245-25), attachments +
                         references (NM-053-26), categories (NW-375-26).
fa.json                  ?domain=niord-fa, EK D 396 and EK R 18 only.
almanac.json, annex.json ?domain=niord-almanac / niord-annex, one each.

                         chain's coastline geometry removed.
